text: To cook, you begin by selecting your ingredients: onions, garlic, and a variety of other aromatics like celery and carrots. Boiling these ingredients with some water and aromatics brings out their natural flavors and textures. The heat of the boiling water helps to break down the cell walls of the onions and release their sweet, pungent aroma. Garlic, with its strong, slightly sweet flavor, can be added after the onions have softened. When the vegetables are ready, they can be added to a pan with olive oil and herbs, such as thyme or rosemary, to enhance the dish. A quick sauté with some salt and pepper can also add depth and aroma to the sauce. Finally, to cook and bring out the flavors, you can simmer the vegetables or use a quick sauté to get everything nice and tender.
